name: Jam
summary: Bug reports with replays and logs.
description: Jam's hosted server reads bug reports with their screen recording, console logs and network requests, so the agent starts debugging from evidence.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (api.jam.dev) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
